entries.460f5f714a5a6a00: It manufactures and sells isononanoic acid (Kyowanoic-N) and octylic acid, which are raw materials for refrigerating machine oil used in air conditioners, freezers and other equipment, and 1, 3-butylene glycol, a raw material for cosmetics and skin care products. The raw materials for refrigerating machine oil are products suited to refrigerants that do not destroy the ozone layer and have a low global warming potential.
entries.7a7412369ae86d65: The group operates a single segment, the Chemicals Business, whose main activity is the manufacture and sale of various petrochemical products. Its core technology is the “Oxo Technology,” which produces aldehydes from olefins and oxo gas as raw materials, and its main production sites are the Yokkaichi Plant (Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture) and the Chiba Plant (Ichihara City, Chiba Prefecture). The company and four subsidiaries and one associate form the group (as of December 31, 2025). Because the reportable segment is only the Chemicals Business, amounts by business field are not given in the descriptions of each field.
entries.b01217c391701df3: It manufactures and sells chemicals used across a wide range of industries, including automobiles and housing, such as solvents for paints like butanol and butyl acetate, and octanol and isononyl alcohol (Oxocol 900), which are raw materials for plasticizers.
entries.b98f9278729e773c: It manufactures and sells high-purity solvents (PM-P, PMA-P) used in the production of liquid crystal displays, semiconductors and photoresists.
entries.c1ed08f486bb0a85: A manufacturer that, with oxo technology at its core, produces and sells chemicals such as raw materials for refrigerating machine oil, cosmetic raw materials, and high-purity solvents for semiconductors.
entries.c7568af062b8cd42: It manufactures and sells isononanoic acid (Kyowanoic-N), a raw material for refrigerating machine oil used in air conditioners, freezers and similar equipment, octylic acid, and 1, 3-butylene glycol, a raw material for cosmetics and skin care products, among other products.
entries.d75f93321a24f465: The group operates a single segment, the Chemicals Business, whose main activity is the manufacture and sale of various petrochemical products.
entries.e546bf4b1f8ad419: It manufactures and sells high-purity solvents (PM-P, PMA-P) used in the production of liquid crystal displays, semiconductors and photoresists. It supplies solvents with extremely low metal content, using quality control know-how built up over many years.
